questions.promptMd: Your harness has no maximum-iteration cap. Which failure is *most* likely to make it unusable?

options.textMd: The model refuses to call any tool
The model returns valid JSON every time
The model keeps calling a tool whose result never satisfies it, consuming time and tokens indefinitely
The tool returns a very large result

questions.explanationMd: Nothing in the model guarantees termination. The cap is the only thing that turns an unbounded loop into a bounded, billable, debuggable one.

questions.promptMd: Which SLI would reveal a broken tool schema first?
questions.explanationMd: A schema the model cannot satisfy shows up immediately as arguments that fail validation. Latency and volume barely move; token counts drift only after the retries pile up.
